Here is an example of how you can create a plot of the function x^2 + 3x - 4 in Manim Community v0.17.3 and make an animation showing the values of the function from x = -10 to x = 10:
```sql
import numpy as np

class FunctionPlot(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        x_values = np.linspace(-10, 10, 100)
        y_values = x_values ** 2 + 3 * x_values - 4

        x_axis = XAxis()
        y_axis = YAxis()
        self.play(x_axis)
        self.play(y_axis)
        self.wait()

        for i, x_value in enumerate(x_values):
            self.play(Label(str(x_value)))
            self.wait()

        for i, y_value in enumerate(y_values):
            self.play(Label(str(y_value)))
            self.wait()

        self.wait(duration=len(x_values) * 10)
```
Note that I used numpy library to generate x\_values and y\_values by `np.linspace(-10, 10, 100)` that means 100 equally spaced values between -10 and 10. You can change the number of x\_values and y\_values as per your requirement.
